title: Forced rerun can be rejected because old degraded records remain in memory

finding.claim: Forced rerun can be rejected because old degraded records remain in memory
finding.evidence: During '--force', the code still appends new records onto any previously loaded records via 'records.append(record)', but the post-run health check evaluates 'degraded = [r for r in records if r.get('degraded')]'. That means a prior degraded record in the existing file will cause the temp file swap to be refused even if every newly generated record in this forced rerun is healthy.
finding.evidence_quote: degraded = [r for r in records if r.get("degraded")]
finding.recommendation: When force is enabled, either clear 'records' before generating replacements, or track newly generated records separately and run the degraded check only against the replacement set that will be written to the temp file.

code_region.text:
# instead of raising, so a force run made while a
            # provider is down would otherwise replace good stored
            # results with all-degraded ones (review-v14 finding
            # [2] — the crash leg was already safe: an exception
            # mid-run never reaches this line and the previous file
            # stays intact). Refuse the swap, drop the temp file,
            # and say so loudly; the operator re-runs when the
            # providers are back.
            degraded = [r for r in records if r.get("degraded")]
            if degraded:
                try:
                    os.remove(write_path)
                except OSError:
                    pass
                raise ValueError(
                    f"bench --force: {len(degraded)} of "
                    f"{len(records)} case(s) for config "
                    f"{cfg['name']!r} came back degraded (a "
                    "provider failed); the previous results file "
                    "was left intact — re-run when the providers "
                    "are healthy")

refutation.quote: degraded = [r for r in records if r.get("degraded")]
refutation.reason: The code region shows the degraded check operates on the full 'records' list, which includes previously loaded records.
